order_placed.title: {side} Order placed
order_placed.description: Limit {side} for {qty} {token} at {price} {currency}. {escrow_amount} {escrow_token} held in escrow. Order #{order_id}.

order_filled.description: {side_past_tense} {qty} {token} at avg. {currency} {avg_price}. Total {total} {currency}, fee {fee} {currency}. Settled onchain. Order #{order_id}.

order_canceled.title: {side} Order canceled
order_canceled.description: Your {side} order for {qty} {token} was canceled. {returned_amount} {returned_token} released from escrow to your wallet. Order #{order_id}.

order_closed.title: Order closed, funds claimable
order_closed._comment: No full description in Notification Text - Equiteez.docx. PDF copy hint: Order closed, funds claimable.

order_expired.title: Order expired
order_expired.description: Your order for {qty} {token} expired. {filled_qty} of {qty} filled. {returned_amount} {returned_token} released from escrow to your wallet. Order #{order_id}.

order_refunded.title: Order funds refunded
order_refunded.description: {amount} {token} from order #{order_id} has been returned to your available balance.

tokens_received.title: Deposit Received
tokens_received.description: {amount} {token} received from {sender}. Available in your wallet now.

tokens_sent.title: Tokens sent

tokens_minted.title: Tokens credited (mint)
tokens_minted.description: {amount} {token} credited to your wallet by {issuer}. Reason: {reason}. Transaction {operation_hash}.

tokens_burned.title: Tokens debited (burn)
tokens_burned.description: {amount} {token} debited from your wallet by {issuer}. Reason: {reason}. Transaction {operation_hash}. Questions? Contact Equiteez support.

launch_purchase.title: Launchpad purchase confirmed (self)

launch_purchase_recorded.title: Launchpad purchase recorded (by admin)

launch_tokens_distributed.title: Launch tokens distributed
launch_tokens_distributed.description: {amount} {token} from the {offering_name} offering have been delivered to your wallet. Transaction {operation_hash}.
